transactionId.description: The unique transaction ID of the validation process in format TID-{proposalId}::{uuid}.

failFast.description: True indicates validations are performed in a fail-fast manner, and will stop the validation process at the first set of errors.

validated.description: The ISO 8601 formatted date time (in UTC) when this validation was executed.

errorDetails.description: The list of error response objects.
